notes: Desktop/floor unit (not rack-mountable) — rackUnits omitted. Sourced from the official FM9 Owner's Manual, Section 2 "The Rear Panel" (pp.21-22) and Section 15 "Specifications" (pp.127-128), current as of FM9 firmware 3.x, August 2022, covering both Original and TURBO hardware variants (I/O identical between variants). Output 1 and Output 3 1/4" jacks use Fractal's proprietary "Humbuster" TRS wiring for noise cancellation but function as standard balanced/unbalanced TRS jacks — mapped to trs-6.35. Input 1 is an unbalanced 1/4" TS instrument jack — mapped to ts-6.35 (distinct from the balanced TRS aux inputs). FASLINK II uses a standard female XLR3 shell for a proprietary 2-way digital control/power protocol between FM9 and Fractal FC-6/FC-12 controllers — it is NOT a standard AES3/analog-audio signal despite the XLR shell; mapped to xlr3 as the closest connector shape with this caveat noted. AC inlet confirmed as standard IEC (C13/C14, universal 90-264VAC) via Fractal's own "IEC Power Cable — Standard C13 to NEMA 5-15P" product listing. USB port confirmed as USB Type-B (USB 2.0, USB Audio Class 2.0, 8-in/8-out) via Fractal wiki/forum since the manual body text doesn't name the physical connector shape explicitly. Pedal jacks 1-3 accept either an expression pedal (10-100kΩ) or an external footswitch (SPST momentary/latching) — control-signal ports, not audio.
